description: Medusa v2.11.1: deep-test pass on live low-coverage modules — red knowledge graph (dedupe/confidence-merge/block checks/corruption recovery), output offloading, firewall defense (validation-before-exec), traffic-log tailing, msf availability probing, session-awareness + http_request. Two real bugs found and fixed: SessionState replayed cookie ATTRIBUTES (Path/Domain) as cookies on every subsequent request; hotfix patch_generator/silent_patch were orphaned and emitted syntactically-broken patches (deleted). 729 tests green.
